Replace the plating-only check with coverage of every internal ice-strengthened structure within the applicable hull area, including plated members adjacent to shell and stiffener webs/flanges; do not require the range object to be nltl:internalStructure when the canonical relationship range is nltl:internalIceStrengthenedStructure. Preserve corrosionAbrasionAllowance only on its authoritative plating owner, and obtain the canonical property/path needed to validate the required addition for non-plating stiffener webs and flanges. Also account for the COMPLETE dependency-contract operands asBuiltThickness and corrosionAbrasionAddition where required by the comparison model; the current graph omits them and cannot represent the full requirement.
